summary: Backend testing for MOCKIFY Interview Simulator completed successfully. Ran 17 pytest tests covering all required endpoints (start/get/list/answer/feedback/transcribe) across all 4 interview types with real Claude Sonnet 4.5 + Whisper integrations. 100% pass rate.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: logger is defined after routes use it (line 320 vs usage on lines 161/193/235). In practice it works because handlers run post-import, but conventionally logger should be configured near top. Non-blocking.

Minor: generate_feedback fallback returns score 60 with generic 'Feedback generation encountered an issue' summary on JSON parse failure. Consider surfacing a 502 instead of silently returning low-signal feedback in production.

Observation: start_interview uses max(3, min(num_questions, 8)) so 1-2 requested questions silently become 3, and >8 becomes 8. This matches the spec (3-8) but isn't documented in the API error response.
All MongoDB queries correctly use projection {'_id': 0} so no ObjectId leakage verified. list_sessions also strips _id.
CORS allow_origins reads from env and splits by comma; allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' is technically not spec-compliant but works for testing.
seed_data_creation: Created 5 TEST_ prefixed interview sessions across the 4 interview types (technical, behavioral, system_design, product_management) + 1 for num_questions clamp test. Data persists in test_database.interview_sessions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend APIs are working: POST /api/interview/start (all 4 types + validation + clamping), GET /api/interview/{id}, GET /api/interview (list, sorted desc), POST /api/interview/answer (with padding and next_index/done), POST /api/interview/{id}/feedback (Claude returns structured JSON matching full schema including per_question_feedback), POST /api/interview/transcribe (Whisper accepts WAV via multipart, returns transcript string). No _id leaks. CORS headers present. Feedback generation with Claude Sonnet 4.5 takes ~15-30s. Frontend not tested per request.
